meaning:
§ Kedemoth = "eastern"
one of the towns in the district east of the Dead Sea allotted to the tribe of Reuben and given to the Merarite Levites

elsewhere.note: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;
